title: With Settings — App only, the turn-on window still flags customers
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Use a new organization in which the Internal Work Orders setting has never been switched on.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A with no open work orders.
  • Sign in as a user whose role has 'Settings — App' but not 'Customers — Create & Edit', at the test location.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings > Work Orders.
  2. Switch the "Internal Work Orders" toggle on.
  3. Pick customer A in the customer picker.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Open the Customers list.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The toggle is off.

Step 2:

  • The "Which customers are your own company?" window opens.

Step 3:

  • Customer A shows as a chip.

Step 4:

  • The window closes and the toggle shows on.

Step 5:

  • Customer A shows the "Internal" badge.
  • Customer A's page offers no Edit Customer to this user.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-11758 (Story 1, Turn on Internal Work Orders, flag internal customers, manage categories)

  • S1-N2: “If the user has 'Settings — App' but not 'Customers — Create & Edit', the modal of S1-R2 still works and Save flags the picked customers (flagging from Settings is part of the setting); the Edit Customer path is not available to them, as the dialog is not.”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions (Action | Needs | Without it): “Flag customers in the first-time modal | 'Settings — App' only | Not applicable; flagging there is part of the setting (S1-N2)”
